heads.t: 目標五合一全壘打 國民黨金門縣黨部召開固本會報座談會 2026/11/02 為迎戰年底五合一地方選舉，中國國民黨金門縣黨部近期密集到各鄉鎮舉辦「固本會報座談會」。 新任縣黨部主委楊鎮浯表示，自10月1日發布接任主委消息後，至10月28日正式舉行新任主委布達典禮前，便已馬不停蹄深入金門各鄉鎮及基層社區，陸續舉辦固本會報，蒐集地方民意，傾聽基層黨員及鄉親心聲。他強調，自己從原本「被推薦的從政黨員」，轉換為肩負黨務整合及選戰責任的「主持會報操盤主委」，未來將全面整合地方組織力量，團結黨內同志，全力投入輔選工作。…
heads.en: In response to the end of the year's five-and-one-round election, the National Democratic Party's Golden Gate County Department has recently intensified its efforts to hold a "Sultan Union" conference in various towns. The new Governor of the county party, Yang Zheng, stated that since the announcement of the announcement of his appointment on October 1, and before the official ceremony of the new President, which took place on October 28, he had been able to reach out to all the towns and sub-districts of Kimmen, and that he had continued to run a solid paper, gathering local opinion and listening to the views of the members of the party at the grass-roots level and the local community. He stressed that he would move from being a "nominated member of the party" to a "hosting committee" with responsibility for the integration of party affairs and the election campaign, and that the future would bring together local organizations, rallying comrades within the party, and working hard for the elections. heads.t: 印象金門詩畫浯江 棠風演出舞蹈詩舞劇 2026/11/02 舞台燈光亮起，舞姿翩然綻放！由金門棠風舞蹈團籌備的大型舞蹈詩舞劇《印象金門詩畫浯江》於文化局演藝廳演出。 本次演出由金門縣文化局主辦、金門棠風舞蹈團承辦，文化局副局長李海瑩與鄉親及藝文愛好者一同欣賞舞團精彩的節目內容。演出以舞蹈為媒介，融合金門歷史、人文、戰地記憶、海洋意象及在地文化，透過舞蹈、音樂與戲劇的多元呈現，帶領觀眾從不同角度認識金門的土地故事與文化底蘊。…
heads.en: Impressed by Kimmen's poems, Tung Feng's performance of the dance poem, 2026/11/02, the stage lights up and the dance is in motion! The big dance poem "Impressional Goldenman Poetry " , organized by the Golden Monroe Dance Group, was performed in the cultural hall. The performance was hosted by the Golden Gate County Cultural Department and organized by the Golden Meng Feng Dance Group, and the Vice-President of the Department of Culture, Li Hae-chung, and his countrymen and art lovers shared the great show. The performance, which consists of dance as a medium, combines the history of the Golden Gate, the humanities, the memories of the war, the images of the sea and the culture of the Earth, and through the diversity of dance, music and drama, leads the viewers to the story of the Golden Gate and its cultural background from different angles. I don't know.

heads.t: 相伴，就是最好的風景 2026/11/02 歲月匆匆，走過人生一段路之後，才發現旅行的意義，早已和年輕時不太一樣。 年輕時出門，總想著要多去幾個地方、多看幾處風景，行程排得滿滿的，深怕錯過什麼。如今再出發，反而喜歡把腳步放慢。遇見喜歡的景色就停一停，累了就找個地方坐一坐，不再追著時間跑，也不再計較一天究竟去了多少景點。 這次旅途中，我們來到古塔前。高大的古塔靜靜矗立在綠樹之間，走過漫長歲月，依然保留著古樸而沉穩的模樣。 站在塔下抬頭望去，忽然覺得，人和一座古塔相比，人生真的只是短短的一程。於是，我們在塔前留下了一張合照。照片裡沒有特別漂亮的衣服，也沒有刻意安排的姿勢，只是很自然地靠在一起。…
heads.en: Together, it's the best view, 2026/11/02, and it's only a little bit of time before you realize what travel is like when you're young. When I was young, I wanted to go to a few more places, to see a few more scenes, to be busy, to be afraid of missing something. Now we go again and we like to slow down. If you're tired, you're tired and you're not chasing the time, and you're not counting on how many places you've gone. On this journey, we come to Guta. And the towers of the towers stood still between the green trees, walking long and long, and still remained as old and steady. heads.t: 夢回東台重遊西溪唐塔 2026/11/02 明洪武廿年（1387），朱元璋命江夏侯周德興來閩督建衛、所，次年在浯洲建置守禦千戶所，以有「固若金湯、雄鎮海門」之勢，名曰「金門城」，這也是金門得名的由來。 相傳周德興在築城同時也建有三座以條石壘成，型制大致相同的石塔，即太武山「倒影塔」、南磐山「文台寶塔」和水頭金龜山「茅山塔」。 地方上對這三座石塔有一些傳說，一說都是做為航海指標，二說是庇佑士林科舉連捷，三說是洪武帝偶聞東南海上有天子之氣，才指派周侯南下建塔鎮壓，毀壞逐鹿天下的好地理。事隔六百多年，真相因年湮代遠，難以探究大白。…
heads.en: Dreams of returning to West Creek Tangtas 2026/11/02 Minghong's 20th year (1387), Zhu Yuan Yuan Jiejiang Jie Hoe-hyun came to build security and shelter, and the next year he built a house in Zhong Cai, known as the Golden Gate. At the same time, Zhou Deok-hyun built three stone towers in the same shape, namely, the Tai Moo Mountain "Foundation Tower", the Southern Rock "Beauta" and the Head of Water Tortoise "Mao Tower". There are local legends about these three towers, which say that they serve as seamarks, that they protect the Yushi Linko, and that it is the Hong Wu Emperor who hears of heaven in the southeast sea before he assigns power to build towers down south of Zhou Hoon and destroys the good geography of deerry. More than 600 years later, the truth is too long to be explored.
